long_biography.plain_text:
After Hurricane Dorian devastated the Bahamas in 2019, helicopter pilot Justin C. Johnson and his wife Angela used Timberview Helicopters to help Medic Corps reach remote communities. They located residents sheltering amid debris on Abaco Island and returned with food, water, baby supplies and tarps.

Johnson’s aviation business predates that relief work. He began operating Timberview in Destin around 2011 and initially partnered with Charles Duplantis and Ray Watson to offer sightseeing flights from the local airport. He is president of both Timberview Helicopters and Timberview Choppers. The company continues to fly scenic tours along the Emerald Coast, and Johnson manages its private Destin heliport.
long_biography.html:
After Hurricane Dorian devastated the Bahamas in 2019, helicopter pilot Justin C. Johnson and his wife Angela used Timberview Helicopters to help Medic Corps reach remote communities. They located residents sheltering amid debris on Abaco Island and returned with food, water, baby supplies and tarps.

Johnson’s aviation business predates that relief work. He began operating Timberview in Destin around 2011 and initially partnered with Charles Duplantis and Ray Watson to offer sightseeing flights from the local airport. He is president of both Timberview Helicopters and Timberview Choppers. The company continues to fly scenic tours along the Emerald Coast, and Johnson manages its private Destin heliport.
